title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・最たる光満ちて今

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By defeating the Eternal Top Three, Mejiro Ardan successfully overturns a once inevitable destiny. Her win is so magnificent that even Inari One and Super Creek celebrate her success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Impressed, Oguri Cap likens her running to the prismatic shine of a glass ornament.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Echoing in celebration of Mejiro Ardan's victory, the crowd's voices extol the "Eternal Top Four," now expanded to include the day's winner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan sears her peerlessly bright light into the fleeting moment, leaving a dazzling trail that will shine on for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully spent after the race, Mejiro Ardan leans on me for support amidst thunderous applause and cheers of her name.
